claims.assertion: Athena says hyperspace navigation uses frequency maps and precise engines to emulate a destination bubble, rematerializing there instead of crossing intervening space.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her account distinguishes this from ordinary travel.

claims.assertion: Ship computers extrapolate uncharted regions from surrounding energy patterns and can predict near-term movement; map coverage and engine precision limit destinations.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says hyperspace capability also enables time travel and matter or situation manipulation; High Council ethics restrict use because it can alter perception and lived experience.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She describes these as shared social rules.
